correctness.rationale: Checked X=∂Δ(A)*∂Δ(B), each |A|=|B|=4, is S5 and its D²(X) has pair vertices. Partition D²(X)=C∪Y where C is the 2-skeleton of Δ_4,4 (16 vertices,72 edges,96 triangles) and Y is K_6,6 with sixteen K_3,3 subgraphs coned off (28 vertices,132 edges,144 triangles); their intersection is 16 discrete cross vertices. Chessboard connectivity makes C simply connected; each 4-cycle in K_6,6 splits into cycles with intersecting A and B pairs killed inside one of the specified cones, hence Y simply connected. Each connected 2D complex has χ=40 and therefore wedge39 S² by Hurewicz/Whitehead. Their homotopy pushout over 16 discrete points adds 15 free circle factors, proving ∨15 S¹∨∨78 S² integrally. Independent enumeration gives face vector (28,204,240), ordinary Betti (1,15,78); modular arithmetic alone does not establish π1 or torsion-free integral homotopy.
